capabilities: Push note checklists to Kan.bn as boards, lists, and cards
Pull card completion, due dates, labels, and members back into notes
Browse and drag-and-drop Kan boards in a sidebar view
Edit cards, comments, checklists, and attachments from a detail modal
Manage Kan workspaces, invites, webhooks, and Trello/GitHub imports
disambiguation: Not a local kanban board editor; boards live on Kan.bn (or a self-hosted Kan instance) and the note remains the source of truth for the plan.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that data.json contains the API key and syncs with the vault, so it should be gitignored in public repos; installation via BRAT is also documented.
problem: Obsidian checklists are static text, so tracking execution state (in progress, done) across a team requires duplicating plan data in an external board tool.

relations.evidence: Sync your Obsidian checklists with Kan.bn kanban boards

summary: Syncs Obsidian note checklists with Kan.bn kanban boards, pushing checklist items as cards and pulling board status back into notes.
